To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
T3 acts via UCP3 to stimulate energy metabolism in mice, and this effect is observed only during the active period of the animals.
T3 acts via UCP3 to maintain body temperature and to correct the dramatic cold intolerance in the β-less mice, and that this effect is observed only during the period of food intake.
the thermogenic effect of T3 is not mediated by UCP1 in BAT but by UCP3 in skeletal muscle.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of new molecular targets that are involved in the action of T3 in the control of body temperature.
the molecular mechanisms by which T3 stimulates the thermogenesis in the β-less mice, and the possible involvement of UCP3 in this mechanism.
the molecular mechanisms of energy metabolism and its control by T3.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
UCP3 is a target of T3 in muscle.
the thermogenic effects induced by T3 are not mediated by UCP3, but rather by BAT UCP1, in the β-less mice, whereas UCP3 might also be involved in the thermogenic response to T3 in WT mice.
T3 stimulates energy expenditure by acting on UCP1 in the BAT and on UCP3 in the skeletal muscles.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
T3 stimulates energy expenditure in mice, at least in part, via a UCP3-dependent mechanism.
T3 stimulates thermogenesis in β-less mice by a direct effect on UCP3, which is expressed in muscle, and that UCP3 is a new molecular target for the thermogenic action of T3.
the thermogenic effects induced by T3 in the β-less mice are mediated by UCP3 in skeletal muscle.
The main takeaway from our work is that
UCP3 is a new target of T3 in skeletal muscle, which may contribute to the thermogenic action of T3.
UCP3 could be a molecular target of T3 in skeletal muscle, which could explain, at least in part, the permissive effect of this hormone on the thermogenic effect of noradrenaline in skeletal muscle.
the thermogenic effect of T3 is not limited to the BAT but also affects skeletal muscle, and that this effect is mediated at least partly through UCP3.
